metadata.prompt: put 5,000 USDT into NVDA and AAPL, 60/40, max 0.6% slippage
metadata.summary: Allocate 5000 USDT across NVDAx, AAPLx at equal weight.

prompt: put 5,000 USDT into NVDA and AAPL, 60/40, max 0.6% slippage
explanation:
Deploy 5,000 USDT across 50% NVDAx (at least 13.7421 NVDAx), 50% AAPLx (at least 10.7568 AAPLx), with at most 0.60% slippage per leg.
Solvers get 15 seconds to bid, then 15 minutes to settle.
Solver fee is capped at 0.30% of the notional.
Settlement may never spend more than 5,000 USDT.
